entities.summary: Tarako (b. 1960-12-17, Ōta-shi) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Ōta-shi and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, composers & musicians, asia.
